title: Stability and Bifurcation Analysis of Nonlinear PDEs via Random Projection-based PINNs: A Krylov-Arnoldi Approach
abstract: arXiv:2603.21568v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We present a numerical framework for the stability and bifurcation analysis of nonlinear partial differential equations (PDEs) in which the solutions are sought in the function space spanned by physics-informed random projection neural networks (PI-RPNNs), and discretized via a collocation approach. These are shallow, single-hidden-layer networks with randomly sampled and fixed a priori hidden-layer weights; only the linear output layer weights are optimized, reducing training to a single least-squares solve. This linear output structure enables the explicit generalized eigenvalue formulation governing the linear stability of stationary solutions, separating the physical domain interior dynamics from the algebraic constraints imposed by boundary conditions (BCs), at no additional training cost and without requiring additional PDE solves. translated_title: 基于随机投影物理信息神经网络的非线性偏微分方程稳定性与分岔分析：一种Krylov-Arnoldi方法
translated_abstract: 我们提出了一种用于非线性偏微分方程（PDE）稳定性与分岔分析的数值框架，其中解在由物理信息随机投影神经网络（PI-RPNNs）张成的函数空间中寻求，并通过配点法进行离散化。这些是浅层的单隐层网络，其隐层权重是随机采样并事先固定的；只需优化线性输出层权重，从而将训练简化为单次最小二乘求解。这种线性输出结构使得能够显式地建立控制稳态解线性稳定性的广义特征值公式，将物理域内部动力学与边界条件（BCs）施加的代数约束分离开来，且不产生额外的训练成本，也不需要额外的PDE求解。然而，随机投影配点矩阵在数值上本质上是秩亏的，
tldr: 本文提出一种基于物理信息随机投影神经网络的数值框架，利用显式广义特征值公式和Krylov-Arnoldi方法，在不增加训练成本或额外PDE求解的情况下实现非线性偏微分方程的稳定性与分岔分析。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a numerical framework based on physics-informed random projection neural networks that enables stability and bifurcation analysis of nonlinear PDEs through an explicit generalized eigenvalue formulation and a Krylov-Arnoldi approach, at no additional training cost or extra PDE solves.
